reason: The cited evidence (E1) only demonstrates that an ESD HfNbTaTiZr coating improves aqueous corrosion resistance on stainless steel at room temperature. It provides no data on high-temperature oxidation resistance, oxygen diffusion barrier properties, thermal expansion compatibility, or mechanical performance under load for equiatomic cast HfNbTaTiZr. The key premises about high-temperature oxygen protection and mechanical property retention are therefore unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: ESD can deposit a dense, adherent HfNbTaTiZr coating
The coating will form a protective oxide scale that limits oxygen diffusion
The coating will remain adherent and crack-free under mechanical load at up to 1000 °C
The coating will preserve the substrate's room-temperature ductility and high-temperature strength
ESD has been shown to enhance corrosion resistance in similar HEA systems
